verdict.rationale: Jeeves' own docs describe Jeeves Cash as multi-currency accounts with multi-currency balance storage. Founders can hold, manage and receive USD, EUR, GBP and CAD in one free business account, with instant FX conversion between those balances. Balances can also be reviewed through the MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration; balance holding covers only four currencies, versus 40+ for payouts.
